metadata.title: Integrated laboratory evolution and rational engineering of GalP/Glk-dependent Escherichia coli for higher yield and productivity of L-tryptophan biosynthesis

reference.title: Integrated laboratory evolution and rational engineering of GalP/Glk-dependent Escherichia coli for higher yield and productivity of L-tryptophan biosynthesis

target.condition: LB overnight, wash x3 M9, M9 glucose sole carbon source, initial OD600 0.10

trigger.observation: Stoichiometric analysis: PTS consumes 1 mol PEP per mol glucose, capping theoretical Trp yield at 0.227 g/g; >80% of PEP could be freed in a PTS-defective GalP/Glk strain (theoretical 0.454 g/g).
trigger.reasoning: Create PTS-defective Trp producer to redirect PEP from glucose uptake into Trp biosynthesis
trigger.source_location: E. coli S028TS/pCas9 (S028 + chromosomal Ptac-tnaC-eGFP biosensor)

evidence.source_location: Parental S028 context (functional PTS) as benchmark in subsequent experiments

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Chemical-stoichiometry-based theoretical yield plus measured growth phenotype of the knockout.

alternatives.approach: Glf (Z. mobilis)/Glk and GalP/Glk activation cited as alternative glucose-uptake restorations (literature background, not tested here)

decision_chain.implementation_detail: CRISPR/Cas9 knockout of ptsI (PTS Enzyme I) -> strain G028; growth evaluated in M9 + glucose, 60 h

result.after: G028 reached only OD600 0.21±0.02 after ~60 h; glucose uptake/growth severely blocked

decision_chain.rule: When producing PEP-dependent aromatics such as L-tryptophan in E. coli, apply PTS inactivation with a PTS-independent glucose uptake route (GalP/Glk), because PTS consumes one PEP per internalized glucose and its removal frees PEP for product biosynthesis.
decision_chain.calibration_reason: reason_nature 存在多个标签（Case 1），需人工确认是否两者都成立

target.condition: CRISPR/Cas9 editing; details delegated to Supplement

trigger.observation: Need for an sgRNA target sequence at the glk locus to apply CRISPR/Cas9 promoter replacement.
trigger.reasoning: Build host enabling CRISPR/Cas9-facilitated promoter engineering of galP/glk

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Physical construction with antibiotic selection; construction itself is measured, downstream function tested in E3.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Replace glk promoter -50..0 bp with chloramphenicol resistance gene CmR to provide sgRNA target and selection marker -> G028Δglk::CmR (G028Cm)
decision_chain.rule: When performing CRISPR/Cas9-mediated chromosomal promoter replacement in E. coli, first insert an antibiotic-resistance marker at the target locus, because it simultaneously provides selection and a unique sgRNA target for the subsequent library swap.

target.condition: M9 deep-well screen; FM-III, 50 mL conical tubes, 37 C 250 rpm; 10 h assay

trigger.observation: ptsI knockout strain G028 showed near-zero growth in M9+glucose (OD 0.21 after 60 h), i.e. native galP/glk expression insufficient to restore glucose uptake.
trigger.reasoning: Recover glucose utilization/growth of the PTS-defective strain by modulated galP/glk expression

evidence.source_location: S028 positive control (H1-H6); G028GG non-mutated synthetic promoters reference (H7-H12)

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Measured screen and fermentation readouts for 84/12 mutants.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Random mutagenesis of -10/-35 elements of ptac-galP and pJ23119-glk cassette (plasmid library pCmN20-GGMT), CRISPR/Cas9 chromosomal integration, growth-coupled + Trp-biosensor screening (CGSS): 84 mutants in 96-deep-well M9, then 12 mutants in FM-III batch

result.metric: OD600 and MFU heat maps; batch fermentation growth/MFU
result.after: 12 mutants with growth >1.25 and high MFU; D10/E12/F8/G1 best in FM-III but still below S028

target.condition: fed-batch DASGIP, 500 mL start, initial glucose 25 g/L, OD600 0.45, 65 h

trigger.observation: Best promoter mutants (D10/E12/F8/G1) still grew and produced below S028 in FM-III batch fermentation.
trigger.reasoning: Further improve GalP/Glk-dependent strain by batch adaptive evolution

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Fed-batch measurements of the evolved strain.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Batch-mode ALE campaign (details in Supplementary Materials); best strain K3 evaluated by fed-batch vs S028; galP/glk/galR sequenced

result.metric: growth, Trp, yield, qTrp, glucose uptake, shikimate, pyruvate; Sanger sequencing of galP/glk/galR
result.after: K3 yield 0.137 g/g (< S028 0.150 at 50 h); growth restored after 30 h; glucose uptake 4.10 g/L/h (40-50 h); pyruvate 2.95 g/L (~5x S028); lower shikimate; no galP/glk/galR mutations

target.condition: SynM + 15 ug/mL Cm + 25 ug/mL Kan + arabinose, 30 C; colonies on SynM agar 30 h; FM-III shake flasks 20 h

trigger.observation: Batch-ALE strain K3 increased glucose uptake but not Trp yield and accumulated ~5x pyruvate, suggesting evolution favored growth pathways over Trp; a sensor-guided continuous selection was needed to keep selection on productivity.
trigger.reasoning: Obtain a higher-yield GalP/Glk-dependent Trp producer via automated continuous evolution
trigger.source_location: E. coli G028Cm/pJC184/pCas9MT (G028JC) with chromosomal promoter library

evidence.source_location: S028, K3, G028c as positive/reference controls in colony characterization

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Real-time measured evolution trajectories and offline fermentation characterization.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Continuous auxostat evolution (auto-CGSS): pJC184 arabinose-induced in vivo mutagenesis, OD600 held at 0.8 via automated inlet/outlet pumps (60-80 mL/h, 30 mL vessel), online flow-cytometric Trp fluorescence; two phases (0-380 h, 381-550 h) with G028c as phase-1 winner; colony screening and FM-III characterization -> T5

result.metric: real-time OD600 + MFU; offline growth/MFU; batch fermentation
result.after: Phase peaks ~11,446 MFU (126 h) and ~13,541 MFU (390-438 h) followed by decline (growth-over-production drift); 10 mutants with MFU >10,000; T5 best in FM-III and selected for fed-batch

target.condition: DASGIP fed-batch 65 h, initial glucose 25 g/L, OD600 0.45

trigger.observation: pJC184 mutagenesis plasmid would cause undesired continuing mutations during fermentation.
trigger.reasoning: Stabilize T5 genotype and evaluate production performance

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Measured fed-batch performance of the cured strain.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Remove mutagenesis plasmid pJC184 via IPTG-inducible Cas9MT retargeted to CmR (sgRNA-pMB1 -> sgRNA-CmR), then fed-batch of plasmid-free T5 vs S028

result.metric: OD600, DCW, Trp, qTrp, yield, Vp, SA, DSA

trigger.observation: T5 yield still far below theoretical maximum and SA/DSA intermediates accumulated, indicating downstream pathway limitation.
trigger.reasoning: Further raise Trp yield by strengthening downstream/limiting enzymatic steps

evidence.source_location: S028AA vs T5AA; comparison to T5 and S028

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 模型自评(硬): 见 ddr_annotation.evidence_grading_rationale——需人工确认 | Measured fed-batch outcomes of the integrants.
decision_chain.implementation_detail: Chromosomal integration of previously engineered variants aroG^D6G-D7A and AntrpC^R378F into T5 (-> T5AA) and S028 (-> S028AA); comparative fed-batch

result.metric: growth, Trp, glucose, yield, qTrp, Vp
result.after: T5AA yield 0.195 g/g (+18.90% vs T5, +5.41% vs S028AA), Trp 41.49 g/L, qTrp 28.83; S028AA higher final titer (48.27 g/L) and Vp (0.77 vs 0.67) due to better growth
